name: Sal's Furniture Co.
old_description: Discover our showroom through an engaging video that showcases our latest offerings and unique designs. Experience the ambiance and style that sets us apart. Don't miss the chance to see what we have in store for you!
about:
Founded in 1938 in North Providence, Rhode Island, Sal's Furniture Co. has operated continuously in the region for over eight decades. The business is currently managed by Greg, who serves as the primary contact for customer inquiries.

The company operates a showroom offering a curated selection of furniture and mattresses, including Amish-made solid hardwood pieces in oak, cherry, maple, and walnut, as well as Goldbond mattresses, adjustable beds, recliners, accent chairs, rugs, and dining, bedroom, and living room sets. The inventory spans thousands of SKUs, and the showroom features a video tour for remote browsing. Financing options, including a one-year no-interest program, are available.

Sal's Furniture serves residential customers throughout New England seeking an alternative to large chain stores. The company emphasizes personal service, from selection through delivery and placement in the home.

The company states its commitment to providing style, quality, and service at lower prices than competitors, with a guaranteed lowest-price pledge in New England. It differentiates itself through meticulous attention to each transaction and quick response to customer questions before and after the sale.
